output.reason: The evidence states that for cases other than those mentioned in paragraphs 261(1) and (2), pre-payment charges, if any, shall be as per the approved policy of a UCB (para 261(5) residual clause). It also states that for term loans, if pre-payment charges are levied by a UCB, they shall be based on the amount being prepaid. Both elements of the claim are directly supported.
